description.value: Heritage Air Park is an outdoor aircraft display area operated by the Comox Air Force Museum, featuring aircraft models that have flown at 19 Wing Comox — from the Dakota to the Aurora — along with Heritage Stones, a Search and Rescue memorial, and the Clarkston Memorial. Situated on Military Row/Little River Road roughly 600m from the main museum building, the park offers up-close access to historic RCAF aircraft in a relaxed, picnic-friendly setting. It is part of the broader RCAF Museum Enterprise and commemorates West Coast military aviation history dating back to WWII.
